verdict.rationale: SigNoz's dashboard docs cover all three parts of the story. For visualization, there are seven panel types with live preview and drill-down. For variables, it supports dynamic, query, custom and textbox variables. For sharing, there are public URL publishing, team-shareable saved views, and JSON export/editing for dashboards-as-code. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard features, and an enumeration of the seven panel types in the evidence.
